title: Rooted in nature, 'Silent Friend' will change the way you see the trees
summary: A new art-house drama tells three stories that span the century — and connect to one tree. Silent Friend will open your eyes to the beauty of the natural world.
contentText:
Silent Friend, Hannes (Enzo Brumm) is profoundly transformed while caring for a plant.'/> A new art-house drama tells three stories that span the century — and connect to one tree. Silent Friend will open your eyes to the beauty of the natural world.
